_note: 特殊句構未覆蓋 KP 補建：Only ＋ 副詞/介片語置句首引發倒裝（eng.t_sub.special.inversion-only，學測/分科級）。當 Only ＋ 時間/方式副詞片語（only then / only after… / only by… / only when…）置於句首，該子句做助動詞倒裝（同否定副詞倒裝）：Only then did I realize the truth.。鐵律：(1) 倒裝後助動詞在主詞前、主要動詞保持原形：Only then did I realize（×did I realized）；(2) 原句無助動詞時補 do/does/did 置主詞前；(3) Only when ＋ 子句時，倒裝發生在『主句』、不在 only when 子句內：Only when the bell rang did the students leave.。防第二正解：distractor 用原形誤寫、未倒裝、倒裝錯子句鎖唯一解。皆標準英語，以 Swan/Oxford，待英語母語 reviewer 複核。文法單元無音檔。

units.title_zh: Only ＋ 副詞片語置句首引發倒裝（Only then did I realize…）
units.can_do: 我能在句首放 Only ＋ 時間/方式副詞片語（only then、only after…、only by…、only when…）時，讓該子句做助動詞倒裝：助動詞移到主詞前、主要動詞保持原形（Only then did I realize…）；也知道原句沒有助動詞時要補 do／does／did，而 Only when ＋ 子句時倒裝發生在主句、不在 only when 子句裡。
units.situation_group: 特殊句型 Inversion after fronted 'Only'
units.subject: eng

claims.text: When 'Only + a time or manner adverbial' (only then, only after..., only by...) begins the clause, the subject and the auxiliary are inverted: 'Only then did I realize the truth.'
claims.verification_ref: Only ＋ 時間/方式副詞片語置首時，助動詞與主詞倒裝；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: After the inverted auxiliary (do/did/have/will...), the main verb stays in its base form: 'Only then did I realize' (not 'did I realized').
claims.verification_ref: 倒裝的助動詞之後主要動詞保持原形；did I realize（×did I realized）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: If the original verb has no auxiliary, add do/does/did and put it before the subject: 'I realized...' -> 'Only then did I realize...'
claims.verification_ref: 原句無助動詞時補 do/does/did 置主詞前；I realized→Only then did I realize；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: With 'Only when + clause', the inversion happens in the main clause, not inside the 'only when' part: 'Only when the bell rang did the students leave.'
claims.verification_ref: Only when ＋ 子句時，倒裝在主句、不在 only when 子句內；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: When 'Only + a time or manner phrase' (only then, only after the war, only by hard work) comes at the front of a clause, we invert the subject and the auxiliary, just like after a negative word: Only then did I realize the truth.
teach.zh_hint: 當句首是 Only ＋ 時間或方式片語（only then、only after the war、only by hard work）時，要把主詞和助動詞倒裝，就像否定副詞置首一樣：Only then did I realize the truth.（直到那時我才明白真相。）

teach.body: Only after the meeting did he tell us the real reason.
teach.zh_hint: 直到會議之後，他才告訴我們真正的原因。Only after the meeting 置首，助動詞 did 倒裝到主詞 he 前。

teach.body: After the inverted auxiliary, the main verb stays in its base form. If the sentence had no auxiliary, add do/does/did: 'I realized' becomes 'Only then did I realize' - keep 'realize', not 'realized'.
teach.zh_hint: 倒裝的助動詞之後，主要動詞保持原形。原句若沒有助動詞，就補 do／does／did：I realized 變成 Only then did I realize——留原形 realize，不是 realized。

teach.body: Only by practicing every day will you become a better player.
teach.zh_hint: 唯有每天練習，你才會成為更好的球員。Only by practicing every day 置首，助動詞 will 倒裝到主詞 you 前，動詞 become 用原形。

teach.body: With 'Only when + a clause', the inversion happens in the MAIN clause, not inside the 'only when' part: Only when the bell rang did the students leave. The 'only when' clause keeps normal word order.
teach.zh_hint: 用 Only when ＋ 子句時，倒裝發生在「主句」，不在 only when 子句裡：Only when the bell rang did the students leave.（直到鈴響，學生才離開。）only when 子句（the bell rang）維持正常語序。

teach.body: Only when the rain stopped did we go outside to play.
teach.zh_hint: 直到雨停，我們才出去玩。only when 子句 the rain stopped 正常語序，主句 did we go 倒裝。

practice.stem: 選出正確的倒裝：Only then ____ the danger.（直到那時我才意識到危險）

distractor_rationales.did I realized: 倒裝的 did 之後主要動詞保持原形，應為 realize，不是 realized。
distractor_rationales.I realized: Only ＋ 副詞片語置首必須倒裝（助動詞在主詞前）；這句沒倒裝。
distractor_rationales.I did realize: 主詞 I 仍在助動詞前，沒有倒裝；要寫成 did I realize。

practice.feedback: Only then 置首要倒裝、動詞保持原形：Only then did I realize the danger.

practice.stem: 選出正確的倒裝：Only by practicing every day ____ better.（唯有每天練習，你才會變更好）

distractor_rationales.you will get: Only by… 置首必須倒裝（助動詞 will 在主詞前）；這句沒倒裝。
distractor_rationales.will you got: 助動詞 will 之後主要動詞保持原形，應為 get，不是 got。
distractor_rationales.you get: 既沒倒裝也缺助動詞；要寫成 will you get。

practice.feedback: Only by… 置首倒裝、助動詞 will 在主詞前、動詞原形：will you get better.

practice.answer: Only when the bell rang did the students leave.
options: Only when the bell rang did the students leave.
Only when did the bell ring the students left.
Only when the bell rang the students left.
Only when the bell rang did the students left.

distractor_rationales.Only when did the bell ring the students: 倒裝應發生在主句，不在 only when 子句裡；the bell rang 要維持正常語序。
distractor_rationales.Only when the bell rang the students lef: 主句缺倒裝；應為 did the students leave。
distractor_rationales.Only when the bell rang did the students: 倒裝的 did 之後動詞保持原形 leave，不是 left。

practice.feedback: only when 子句正常語序、主句倒裝且動詞原形：Only when the bell rang did the students leave.

practice.stem: 選出正確的倒裝：Only after she left ____ the truth.（直到她離開，我才得知真相）

distractor_rationales.did I learned: 倒裝的 did 之後動詞保持原形，應為 learn，不是 learned。
distractor_rationales.I learned: Only after… 置首必須倒裝（助動詞在主詞前）；這句沒倒裝。
distractor_rationales.I had learn: 沒倒裝、而且 had 之後應接過去分詞 learned，learn 原形也不對。

practice.feedback: Only after… 置首倒裝、動詞原形：Only after she left did I learn the truth.

practice.answer: Only then did I understand what he meant.
options: Only then did I understand what he meant.
Only then I understood what he meant.
Only then did I understood what he meant.
Only then understood I what he meant.

Only then 置首必須倒裝（助動詞在主詞前）；這句沒倒裝。
distractor_rationales.Only then did I understood what he meant: 倒裝的 did 之後動詞保持原形 understand，不是 understood。
一般動詞倒裝要補助動詞 did，不能把主要動詞直接倒裝（×understood I）。

practice.feedback: Only then 置首補 did 倒裝、動詞原形：Only then did I understand what he meant.

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 朗讀＋語調模仿：看句子朗讀→自評（不自動判讀發音）。置首 Only 片語語調略揚、略停頓，倒裝的助動詞與主詞連讀，句尾下收。

lines.text: Only then did I understand how hard she had worked.
lines.intonation: Only then 略揚、略停、did I understand 連讀、句尾下收

lines.text: Only by working together will we finish on time.
lines.intonation: Only by working together 略揚、will we finish 連讀、句尾 on time 下收
